name: Prime Minister's Research Fellowship (PMRF)
funder: Ministry of Education, Government of India
amount: Rs 70,000/month (years 1-2), Rs 75,000 (year 3), Rs 80,000 (years 4-5) + Rs 2 lakh/year research grant
other_rules: PhD fellowship at PMRF-granting institutes (IISc, IITs, IISERs, NITs, IIITs etc.)
direct entry needs CGPA 8.0 plus route-specific criteria (e.g. GATE 650+ or CSIR/UGC JRF rank under 100 for other institutes)
lateral entry for current PhD scholars with CGPA 8.5 over four courses
notes: Two selection cycles a year, around May and December. 31 Oct 2026 is a third-party estimate for the December 2026 cycle; internal institute deadlines come earlier.
